## secure-terminal fuzz seed corpus.
##
## One seed per line: NAME<space>HEX. Hex keeps the file pure ASCII, so
## hostile bytes (C1, bidi, zero-width, combining runs) survive review and
## the repo-wide non-ASCII gate.
##
## Two consumers, deliberately sharing one corpus:
##   - .clusterfuzzlite/build.sh explodes it into $OUT/<harness>_seed_corpus.zip
##     so the atheris fuzzers do not cold-start from empty each run.
##   - dist-ai test_fuzz_harnesses.py drives every harness over it on each
##     push, so a harness that raises is caught by the gate, not a nightly.
##
## Each harness reads these bytes through its own FuzzedDataProvider, so one
## seed exercises a different shape in each.
